name: australian-estate-planning
description: Assemble NSW and Victorian estate planning documents from a provenance-cited instruction record and the firm's human-designed precedents. A separate solicitor-confirmed precedent profile registers exact fill sites, every use checks for anchor drift, and only a working copy is changed. Covers wills and enduring powers of attorney in both jurisdictions, NSW enduring guardianship, and Victorian medical treatment decision-maker appointments, with no document drafted from scratch.
